description:
This file defines a class Colors within the ScssPhp
amespace, which provides static methods and properties for managing CSS color names and their RGB values, including conversion methods between color names and RGBA arrays.

classes.name: Colors
classes.description: Provides static properties and methods for handling CSS color names and conversions.

methods.name: colorNameToRGBa
methods.description: Converts a color name string to an RGBA array if the color exists in the predefined CSS color list.

methods.name: RGBaToColorName
methods.description: Reverse lookup that returns the color name for a given RGBA color if it exists in the predefined list.
